stable.dom: Exact page.content() UTF-8 bytes after scenario assertions, including filled DOM state represented by the page
network: request.url normalized to http://fixture.local with original path/query
stable.screenshot: Equal SHA-256 PNG hashes, following WO-057's equal-hash observation; pinned headless shell, 640x400 viewport, deviceScaleFactor 1, light scheme, reduced motion, animations disabled, caret hidden, CSS scale

omitted.loopback origin port: Ephemeral per-run fixture server allocation; replaced only in stable network URLs
omitted.network headers: HTTP Date, connection and browser-generated transport details are not application behavior assertions; raw trace retains them
omitted.network timing and connection identifier: Scheduler and socket allocation vary; raw trace retains them
omitted.process ids and start times: Per-run ownership identities used for recovery, not application replay
omitted.trace container and metadata: Diagnostic Playwright trace contains runtime times and physical URLs; retained but not compared byte-for-byte
omitted.output directory and caller subject revi: Host identity/provenance varies independently of captured application content
omitted.live input properties outside HTML seria: DOM witness is page.content(), not a claim that HTML serializes every DOM property; accessibility and screenshot also capture the rendered result

scope: One checked-in synthetic form, fetch and console-error page on the WO-057 observed host and pin; no arbitrary target or cross-platform screenshot guarantee
